description: Btdin multifunction measuring unit with RS485, 4 DIN modules, CT connection
source: BTicino, "Btdin Multif. Measuring Unit RS485 - Cat.No F4N200" Modbus table, IDP000050EN_02

sources.title: Btdin Multif. Measuring Unit RS485 - Cat.No F4N200 (Modbus table)

notes: Modbus RTU over RS485, FC03 (and FC04 for input registers) reads, FC16 writes; big endian.
Powers and energies change scale with CT×VT: powers are 0.01 W (var, VA) below 5000 and 1 W from 5000; energies count 10 Wh up to 1000000 Wh depending on CT×VT (document notes 1 and 2).
Signs of the per-phase powers are separate registers (0 positive, 1 negative).
Changing settings: write 0x5AA5 to 0x2700, write the settings, write 0x5AA5 to 0x2700 again and 0x000A to 0x2600 to save; 0x000B to 0x2800 restores the defaults.
